plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Full shared package with local agents, skills, hooks, instructions, contexts, MCP assets, scripts, wrappers, plus bundled Matt diagnose for bug workflows.

plugins.name: catchup
plugins.description: Resume interrupted project work by locating and following the best handover before doing fresh discovery. Use when starting in an existing repo/worktree, after context loss or /clear, when the user says catchup/continue/resume/handover, or when asked what changed or what is next.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Use for review requests. Prioritizes bugs, regressions, risks, and missing tests.

plugins.name: codebase-index
plugins.description: Use when the codebase graph is missing or stale. Rebuild the codebase-memory index first.

plugins.name: codebase-memory
plugins.description: Use for graph-aware codebase exploration, tracing, and reference lookup.

plugins.name: commit-push-merge
plugins.description: Publish and merge a branch by committing local changes when needed, pushing, and merging after inferring or confirming the target and method. Use when the user asks to commit, push, and merge or to direct-merge a branch.

plugins.name: commit-push-pr
plugins.description: Publish a branch by committing local changes when needed, pushing, and opening or updating a pull request. Use when the user explicitly asks to commit and push with a PR, open a PR, or publish the current branch for review.

plugins.name: debate
plugins.description: Use for deep tradeoff analysis on architectural decisions, technology choices, and feature proposals. Tests an idea from both sides before recommending a path. Agents may suggest this when the user faces a non-trivial decision.

plugins.name: eli5
plugins.description: Explains a topic at multiple depth levels. Use when a topic needs layered explanation, when the user is confused about a concept, or when the user says "explain X." Agents may suggest this when the user seems unfamiliar with a topic or asks "what is" / "how does" questions.

plugins.name: explore
plugins.description: Use for read-only codebase orientation, file discovery, and path tracing.

plugins.name: go-quality
plugins.description: Use to run Go format, lint, and test checks with the project toolchain.

plugins.name: handover
plugins.description: Save a self-contained recovery prompt for a later agent session in the shared handover store. Use when ending or pausing work, switching context, preserving unfinished implementation state, or when the user asks for a handover.

plugins.name: optimize-steering
plugins.description: Audit and optimize agent-facing markdown files (steering docs, skills, agent definitions) for token efficiency, structural compliance, and cross-model compatibility. Applies research-backed formatting conventions (R1-R7). Runs `steering-audit` first for drift/hook/lint detection. Use when asked to audit agent docs, optimize steering files, refactor SKILL.md, normalize agent instructions, reduce token waste, or fix agent compliance issues. To create a new skill from scratch, use `write-a-skill` instead.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Use when automating browser interactions through a Playwright MCP server.

plugins.name: prompt-lookup
plugins.description: Use when finding, comparing, or improving prompt templates and prompt-engineering patterns.

plugins.name: python-quality
plugins.description: Use to run Python format, lint, type-check, and test commands with the project toolchain.

plugins.name: quick-commit
plugins.description: Create a deliberate local git commit without pushing or opening a PR. Use when the user asks to commit local changes, make a checkpoint commit, or run a fast commit-only workflow.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Use when the user needs open-ended research requiring synthesis across multiple sources — comparisons, technology evaluations, tradeoff analysis. NOT for single-repo "where is X" lookups (use explore), URL-specific fetches (use web-fetch), or speckit research workflows.

plugins.name: rust-quality
plugins.description: Use to run Rust format, lint, and test checks with the project toolchain.

plugins.name: sniff
plugins.description: Use for a stability, hardening, and cleanup audit across a codebase.

plugins.name: speckit-bugfix
plugins.description: Use when fixing bugs in a SpecKit repo. Scales from quick fixes to full bug workflows.

plugins.name: steering-audit
plugins.description: Use to audit agent rules, hooks, skills, and guardrails for drift and cleanup.

plugins.name: typescript-quality
plugins.description: Use to run TypeScript or JavaScript format, lint, type-check, and test commands.

plugins.name: unstuck
plugins.description: Escalate stalled debugging by challenging assumptions after the normal diagnosis loop has failed. Use when repeated fixes, same-file re-editing, flaky evidence, circular hypotheses, or going in circles suggest the agent is stuck; bundled diagnose owns first-pass debugging.

plugins.name: verify
plugins.description: Run and report a final local verification pass before handoff, commit, push, merge, or PR. Use when the user asks to verify, test everything, check readiness, or prove local changes are safe to hand off.

plugins.name: web-fetch
plugins.description: Retrieve current or URL-specific information from the web with source-aware tool routing. Use when the user asks to fetch, open, browse, cite, verify online, inspect a URL, or answer a question whose facts may have changed.

plugins.name: diagrams
plugins.description: Diagram generation bundle that installs draw.io, Excalidraw, and D2 diagram skills for editable architecture, workflow, flowchart, and visual explanation diagrams.

plugins.name: drawio-skill
plugins.description: Third-party draw.io diagram skill for editable architecture, UML, ERD, sequence, flowchart, and process diagrams with local PNG/SVG/PDF export.

plugins.name: excalidraw-diagram-skill
plugins.description: Third-party Excalidraw diagram skill for visual argument diagrams, architecture explanations, and workflow sketches with render validation.

plugins.name: d2-diagram
plugins.description: Third-party D2 diagram skill for text-based architecture, flowchart, data-flow, database, and topology diagrams.

plugins.name: resume
plugins.description: Resume bundle that installs the preferred advanced resume-tailoring workflow plus the broader ResumeSkills career-support bundle.

plugins.name: presentation
plugins.description: Presentation bundle that installs ppt-creator, marp-slide, and pptx-from-layouts for general decks, Marp slides, and PowerPoint template workflows.

plugins.name: ppt-creator
plugins.description: Third-party general-purpose presentation skill for persuasive, data-driven slide decks with speaker notes and PPTX output.

plugins.name: marp-slide
plugins.description: Third-party Marp slide skill with multiple themes, image layouts, and slide design improvements.

plugins.name: pptx-from-layouts
plugins.description: Third-party PowerPoint skill that generates editable PPTX decks from markdown using real slide-master layouts and placeholders.

plugins.name: resume-tailoring
plugins.description: Third-party advanced resume tailoring skill with company research, branching experience discovery, matching strategies, and multi-format output.

plugins.name: tailored-resume-generator
plugins.description: Third-party focused resume tailoring skill that maps job descriptions to candidate experience and ATS-friendly resume output.

plugins.name: resumeskills
plugins.description: Third-party career skills bundle for ATS optimization, resume bullets, job-description analysis, tailoring, interview prep, and job-search support.

plugins.name: hyperresearch
plugins.description: Third-party HyperResearch deep research harness wrapper. Uses upstream HyperResearch's Python installer for runtime Claude assets.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend development bundle with Impeccable design skills, Playwright browser automation MCP, and frontend patterns. Use for projects with web UI, browser testing, or visual design requirements.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Third-party Impeccable frontend design skill bundle.

plugins.name: interface-design
plugins.description: Third-party Interface Design skill for dashboards, admin panels, SaaS apps, tools, and product interfaces.

plugins.name: stitch-skills
plugins.description: Full Google Stitch Agent Skills bundle for Stitch MCP design, DESIGN.md, React, Remotion, shadcn/ui, and taste-design workflows.

plugins.name: work-tools
plugins.description: Personal work workflow bundle for Salesforce activity logging, Excel activity tracking, and read-only work context collection.

plugins.name: matt-skills
plugins.description: Full Matt Pocock skills package.

plugins.name: matt-caveman
plugins.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode.

plugins.name: matt-diagnose
plugins.description: Disciplined diagnosis loop for hard bugs and regressions.

plugins.name: matt-grill-me
plugins.description: Planning grill without project docs.

plugins.name: matt-grill-with-docs
plugins.description: Planning grill using domain docs and ADRs.

plugins.name: matt-improve-codebase-architecture

plugins.name: matt-setup-skills

plugins.name: matt-tdd

plugins.name: matt-to-issues

plugins.name: matt-to-prd

plugins.name: matt-triage
